description: Two hundred, and a road you will not take

participation.context: Refused to go down, and named only what he had seen.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Gave two hundred as her figure from the stair, and sent them back to the house.
participation.name: Goodwife Margery Pell

participation.context: Brought a boy's account with no count, proposed going down, and stayed when you said no.
participation.name: Richard Cowley

participation.context: Refused a third figure, and wrote the agreement as the running only.
participation.name: Humphrey Larkham

relations.note: he will repeat her figure and not adopt it
relations.quote: Two hundred. I will say it as she said it.

story.body: You made them say the one sentence they shared. You refused the walk down. You left Margery's two hundred as hers, and Cowley's account as his, with no count in it.

relations.note: he will repeat her figure and not adopt it
relations.quote: Two hundred. I will say it as she said it.

title: Made them say the one sentence they shared

description: The scene, with the street in it

participation.context: Set the drum against the street, and refused the road a second time.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Heard the shout, looked at Pope, and did not go.
participation.name: Richard Cowley

participation.context: Separated the outside noise from the drum, and did not add a figure.
participation.name: Humphrey Larkham

participation.context: Stayed on his cue, and meant to be louder than the memory of the gate.
participation.name: Thomas Pope

relations.note: the shout is heard, and the door is not taken
relations.quote: You have heard. We have all heard. We are not going down.

story.body: You kept the scene on the drum. You did not send anyone to the gate. You stopped the rehearsal while the stopping was still the company's.

relations.note: the shout is heard, and the door is not taken
relations.quote: You have heard. We have all heard. We are not going down.

title: Rehearsed Richard the Third while the street was still audible

participation.context: Read the plot and played the bill.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You read the plot. Your name was among the players. No author was named. You played.

title: Read the Richard the Third plot and played
